select d.dept_id, d.tenant_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = 0
AND d.dept_name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%')
AND d.status = #{status}
order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
select d.dept_id, d.tenant_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = 0
select count(1) from sys_dept where dept_name = #{deptName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and del_flag = 0 limit 1
select count(*) from sys_dept where status = '0' and del_flag = 0 and find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
